name: monte9
description: Curate Claude Code's own memory files: view every project's memory, and save what a session learned before /clear

plugins.name: view-memory
plugins.description: /view-memory: a pane browsing every auto-memory folder, with search, overdue items, health checks and what each session loads, and a nudge to save once a session runs long

plugins.name: save-memory
plugins.description: /save-memory: save what this session learned to auto memory under a strict bar, verify the index, report the session's cost, then hand back /rename and /clear
